name: Idukki
tagline: The hill district of tea, spices and dams
summary: Idukki: Kerala's highest hill district, with Munnar tea estates, Periyar Tiger Reserve, cardamom plantations, Vagamon and the Idukki arch dam.

history.overview: The district is the heart of the Western Ghats high range, opened up by planters in the 19th century. The Idukki arch dam, built in the 1970s, is a major hydropower and engineering landmark.

timeline.event: Planters open tea and cardamom estates.

unique: Cool high-range climate and tea estates

bestTime.why: Cool, misty hills and clear views.
